films.desc_en: A premium unbranded commercial showing a recurring customer enjoying the fresh daily offerings of her neighborhood supermarket.
films.music: Warm acoustic guitar and light percussion, upbeat, 110 bpm

shots.kf: A 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair wearing a cozy yellow knit sweater stands near a modern, unbranded glass supermarket entrance in a quiet neighborhood. Crisp morning sunlight casts long, soft shadows. 35mm lens, medium-wide shot, warm cinematic color palette, high detail, photorealistic without any text.
shots.motion: The woman takes a slow step forward as the camera slowly pans right to reveal the modern glass storefront. Gentle morning breeze in her hair.

shots.kf: A close-up of rustic, golden-brown crusty loaves of bread resting on a clean wooden bakery shelf inside a supermarket. Soft, warm overhead pendant lighting highlights the texture of the crust. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, earthy tones, highly photorealistic, no labels or tags.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth camera push-in on the crusty bread. Subtle wisps of steam rise gently from the freshly baked loaves against the dark background.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair and yellow knit sweater stands in the fresh produce section, looking at a display of bright green apples. The supermarket aisle is clean with warm wooden accents and bright diffuse lighting. 50mm lens, medium shot, vibrant natural colors, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman turns her head slowly to look at the apples. The camera executes a slow tracking shot moving gently to the left.

shots.kf: A friendly male supermarket cashier in his 40s wearing a crisp, unbranded dark green apron standing behind a sleek wooden checkout counter. He has a warm smile and neat short hair. Soft indoor lighting, 50mm lens, eye-level medium shot, inviting atmosphere, completely unbranded, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The cashier gives a warm, slow nod and smiles gently. The camera remains mostly static with a very subtle, slow zoom-in.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair and yellow knit sweater walks away from the supermarket on a sunny tree-lined pavement, carrying a large brown paper grocery bag. Golden morning light creates a rim light around her. 50mm lens, wide tracking shot, uplifting atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman walks slowly away from the camera down the sunlit pavement. The camera slowly tracks forward behind her, capturing the peaceful neighborhood vibe.

films.line_en: Freshness that makes a real difference.
films.desc_en: A sleek, premium commercial focusing on a single hero product—a perfect crate of fresh tomatoes—in a newly opened modern retail space.
films.music: Modern ambient electronic with a gentle pulse, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Квалитет кој можете да го вкусите.

shots.kf: A pristine, rustic wooden crate overflowing with perfectly round, vibrant red tomatoes covered in fresh morning dew, sitting on a sleek dark display stand. A beam of golden sunlight hits the tomatoes. 85mm macro lens, dramatic lighting, vivid reds and deep shadows, photorealistic, unbranded.
shots.motion: A very slow, majestic camera pan from left to right across the dewy tomatoes. The sunlight catches the water droplets, making them sparkle.

shots.kf: The same wooden crate of vibrant red tomatoes on the dark display stand, now surrounded by a gentle, cooling mist in the modern supermarket produce aisle. Cool, crisp ambient lighting contrasts with the red fruit. 50mm lens, medium close-up, highly detailed texture, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The soft mist rolls gently over the red tomatoes. The camera slowly tilts down to emphasize the fresh, chilled environment of the display.

shots.kf: A wide view of a brand new, empty supermarket aisle featuring dark grey floors and warm wooden shelving illuminated by hidden LED strips. The aesthetic is premium, clean, and modern. 24mm wide-angle lens, deep depth of field, architectural photography style, photorealistic, no text or logos.
shots.motion: A slow, continuous push-in down the center of the flawless supermarket aisle, showcasing the premium lighting and modern interior design.

shots.kf: An out-of-focus silhouette of a person pushing a shopping cart passes behind the hero wooden crate of vibrant red tomatoes in the foreground. The tomatoes remain in sharp focus under warm spotlighting. 85mm lens, extreme shallow depth of field, cinematic bokeh, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The blurred figure in the background slowly moves from left to right. The camera is perfectly locked off, keeping the sharp tomatoes stationary.

shots.kf: A glowing, sunlit close-up of the wooden crate of red tomatoes sitting near a large supermarket window at golden hour. The background is a soft, blurred street scene. Warm, inviting tones dominate the frame. 50mm lens, beautiful lens flares, cinematic and premium, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow, elegant pull-back from the crate of tomatoes as dust motes drift lazily in the beam of warm golden sunlight.

films.desc_en: A fast-paced, vertical social media ad tailored for TikTok and Reels, capturing the energy of a quick grocery run.
films.music: Upbeat lo-fi hip hop instrumental, punchy bass, 120 bpm

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A first-person view looking down at the shiny metal handle of a sleek supermarket shopping cart moving down a brightly lit snack aisle with colorful, unbranded packaging. 24mm wide lens, bright and punchy colors, dynamic perspective, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The shopping cart moves steadily forward down the aisle in a smooth, continuous first-person tracking shot, conveying a sense of walking quickly.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A perfectly chilled, elegant glass bottle of sparkling water covered in condensation, standing on a glowing refrigerated shelf. Dark background with cool blue LED lighting. 85mm macro lens, sharp focus on the water droplets, premium feel, unbranded, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow vertical camera tilt upwards along the length of the chilled glass bottle, highlighting the frosty condensation and premium lighting.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A stylish, unbranded canvas tote bag hanging from a person's shoulder, framed from the torso down, as they walk through modern sliding glass doors into the evening city lights. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, neon reflections, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The tote bag sways gently back and forth with the rhythm of the person's steps. The camera tracks smoothly behind them.

films.line_mk: Гарантираме врвен квалитет на нашите полици.
films.line_en: We guarantee top quality on our shelves.
films.desc_en: A step-by-step visual journey explaining the supply chain of fresh local produce from farm to supermarket.
films.music: Inspiring corporate ambient, driving strings and piano, 105 bpm
vo_mk: Нашиот зеленчук патува директно од локалните плодни ниви.
Секој плод се проверува за совршена зрелост.
Транспортот е секогаш брз и безбеден за свежина.
Вака гарантираме врвен квалитет на нашите полици.

shots.kf: A lush, green agricultural field in North Macedonia at sunrise. The morning mist hangs low over straight rows of crops. Golden light bathes the landscape. 35mm lens, wide sweeping landscape shot, vibrant greens and warm yellows, photorealistic nature photography.
shots.motion: A slow, majestic aerial drone push-in over the green crops, moving steadily towards the rising sun in the distance.

shots.kf: A rustic wooden box overflowing with freshly picked, bright green bell peppers resting on dark, rich soil in a farm field. Sunlight highlights the smooth skin of the peppers. 50mm lens, medium close-up, earthy and natural color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A subtle, slow camera orbit around the wooden box of green peppers, showcasing their fresh texture against the dark soil.

shots.kf: A clean, generic white delivery van driving along a scenic rural road lined with tall green trees. The sky is bright blue with fluffy white clouds. 50mm lens, wide tracking shot, bright daylight, optimistic atmosphere, completely unbranded vehicle, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The white van drives smoothly forward along the road. The camera tracks alongside it at a steady pace, keeping the van centered.

shots.kf: The open back of the white delivery van, revealing neatly stacked, clean wooden crates filled with various vibrant, unbranded vegetables. Soft, diffused daylight enters from the open doors. 35mm lens, interior shot looking in, orderly and clean composition, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow push-in shot moving gently towards the stacked wooden crates inside the van, emphasizing abundance and careful organization.

shots.kf: A generic supermarket employee in a clean, unbranded blue polo shirt pushing a flatbed cart loaded with wooden crates of vegetables through a brightly lit stockroom. 50mm lens, medium shot following the cart, neutral industrial lighting, photorealistic and professional.
shots.motion: The employee walks slowly forward, pushing the cart. The camera tracks backwards smoothly, maintaining a constant distance from the moving cart.

shots.kf: A close-up of the bright green bell peppers neatly arranged in an angled display basket on a pristine supermarket shelf. Warm LED lighting highlights their glossy surface. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, vibrant contrasting colors, photorealistic retail photography.
shots.motion: A slow camera pan across the row of perfectly arranged green bell peppers, highlighting the flawless presentation and retail lighting.

shots.kf: A wide, expansive shot of a fully stocked supermarket produce section. Aisles of colorful fruits and vegetables glow under soft, warm indoor lighting. The floor is spotless and reflective. 24mm lens, deep depth of field, inviting and premium atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow, elegant crane shot booming gently upwards, revealing the full scale and colorful variety of the immaculate fresh produce section.

films.line_mk: Ние сме срцето на вашето маало.
films.line_en: We are the heart of your neighborhood.
films.desc_en: An emotional, music-led cinematic piece portraying the local supermarket as a comforting community hub on a rainy evening.
films.music: Slow cinematic piano and cello, melancholic but warm, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Во секој залак се крие љубов.
Ние сме срцето на вашето маало.

shots.kf: The warm, glowing storefront of a small neighborhood supermarket at dusk during a light rain. The unbranded yellow lights spill out onto the wet pavement, creating a cozy contrast with the cool blue twilight. 35mm lens, wide shot, cinematic lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Rain falls softly in the foreground. The camera slowly pushes in towards the warm, inviting glow of the supermarket windows.

shots.kf: A dark silhouette of a person holding a large black umbrella walking away from the camera towards the glowing, warm entrance of the supermarket. Raindrops splash on the wet street. 50mm lens, moody atmospheric lighting, high contrast, cinematic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The person slowly walks forward under the umbrella. The camera remains static, capturing the gentle movement of the silhouette entering the light.

shots.kf: Inside the supermarket, a soft-focus view of the bakery section bathed in warm amber light. Delicate wisps of steam rise from freshly baked pastries in the foreground. 85mm lens, extreme shallow depth of field, cozy and intimate atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera executes a very slow, subtle pan to the right. Steam gently wafts upward from the warm pastries into the glowing light.

shots.kf: An elderly man wearing a classic flat cap and a tweed jacket stands peacefully in the soft-lit fruit section, looking warmly at a display out of frame. Soft, forgiving light on his face. 85mm lens, medium close-up, emotive portrait style, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The elderly man breathes slowly, a faint, gentle smile forming on his lips. The camera slowly pushes in for a more intimate portrait.

shots.kf: Two plain, unbranded white ceramic coffee cups resting on a warm wooden counter near the supermarket checkout, with soft out-of-focus background lights. A cozy, shared moment. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, moody and warm color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A very slow camera orbit around the two coffee cups. The background lights create shifting, beautiful cinematic bokeh effects as the camera moves.

shots.kf: A close-up of a small rain puddle on the dark pavement. The warm, golden lights of the supermarket storefront reflect beautifully in the rippling water. Evening atmosphere, cool blue and warm gold tones. 85mm macro lens, high detail, poetic and photorealistic.
shots.motion: Gentle raindrops fall into the puddle, creating slow, mesmerizing ripples that distort the golden reflection of the supermarket lights. Static camera.
